name: Binary Notation
description: You are given a positive integer n . Output its binary notation.
input_specification: The only line of input data contains an integer n ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 10 6 ).
output_specification: Output the binary notation of n (without any leading zeros).
approach_summary: Identify exchange argument or greedy choice property. Sort elements by payoff ratio or deadline and greedily pick candidates to achieve global optimum.
